hooks.name: Git Safety Guard
hooks.description: Prevents direct push to main and requires PR branch workflow (IDE only, skipped on spot)

action.command: bash -c '[ "$KIRO_SPOT" = "1" ] && exit 0; read INPUT; CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "(git push|gh pr merge)"; then if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "gh pr merge.*--admin"; then echo "Admin merge blocked. Wait for CI and proper review." >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git push.*(origin\s+main|origin/main|HEAD:main)"; then echo "Direct push to main blocked. Use a feature branch and open a PR." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi'
